Variants.Content: House Sandry is based on Saltcliff Island and is an island vassal of the Iron Islands. The fishing grounds, salt marshes, harbors and longship routes of Salt Cliff Island have shaped family life. The islanders not only fear the Drowned God, but also must deal with daily food in storms and barren land. The Ironborn nobles often speak loudly about the glory of the sea, but Sandri's daily life reminds people that repairing nets, pickling fish, identifying storms and funerals also belong to the Iron Islands.

The princes of the Iron Islands looked at Sandri, focusing on its harbor, ships and whether it could respond to the call of the islands. Xiaojiamen is not qualified to talk only about his own honor, because every ship needs other people's wood, food and courage.

The Sandley Islanders knew that the sea would give fish and take away fathers and brothers. If the lord can fairly allocate the fishing grounds and repair the docks, he will gain stronger loyalty than the cheers at the banquet.
Entry Sunderly Entry Sunderly The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Sunderly Entry Sunderly Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.

Entry Sunderly Entry Sunderly The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Sunderly Entry Sunderly They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
